searchQueries.query: West Palm Beach Florida official parcel GIS property appraiser parcel data feature service
searchQueries.scope: Find city/county first-party parcel map and determine whether public geometry can be read safely.
searchQueries.result: Official City GIS metadata exposes a polygon Parcels feature layer copied monthly from Palm Beach County; official County Property Appraiser GIS identifies the county map as the official property-ownership map. A safe county-level exact-point query returned one full polygon with only OBJECTID. The WUP locator projects outside the City GIS layer extent, so the County sample is not claimed as city-bound.
searchQueries.executionMethod: Separate language-specific web search and first-party source/service review; no property-specific record lookup.

County Property Appraiser describes the county GIS as the official parcel ownership map.
Public polygon layer metadata; safe query requested only OBJECTID and geometry.
